title: More Grind
description: Redefines the core loop to make progression longer and more grindy.
body:
![The Sifter workbench GUI. There is 1 copper dust in the first slot, 1 copper sifting hammer in the second slot, and the output slot is empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06fcb62a292250065d000e8aec3c1a76d1112327_0.webp)

Do you wish it took longer to get ores?

This mod is for you!

This mod redefines the mining loop, mainly by requiring ores to smelt/blasted into ore dusts, which then must be compacted at the new Sifter workbench.

JEI Support included!

Features:

- Adds Copper Nuggets and Diamond Shards, material equivalent nuggets for copper and diamonds

![A copper nugget and a diamond shard, both in item frames](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34cbc3ac219f489886d3e167b9664edfb777d1cc.png)

- Diamonds no longer drop from diamond ore. Instead, diamond ore drops raw diamond.

![Raw diamond in an item frame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b16ac607e165615ebcd9c5c52dd06b98031dd983.png)

- Adds Ore dusts (copper, iron, gold, diamond), which are obtained from smelting or blasting raw ores.

![Copper, iron, gold, and diamond dust, all in item frames](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf1816dee680266092f7d277fa2aa674fd545078.png)

- Adds Sifters and Iron Sifters, a new workbench, and it's upgrade. These workbenches allow you to compact ore dust into nuggets of the corresponding material at a rate of 5:1 and 3:1 respectively.

![Sifter Workbench](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1af6d906e114d4e4b65c79bcf98b762f21d862e6_0.webp)

![Iron Sifter Workbench](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10824a83da035374b352e02acb94c79994474f50_0.webp)

- Adds Sifting Hammers, a new tool required to use Sifters and Iron Sifters

![Stone, Copper, Iron, Gold, and Diamond Sifting Hammers, all in item frames](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/275f04e4aa4e6a25331dfb1df252277f01e075ec.png)

- Adds Tool Handles, a new item required to craft Sifting Hammers

![A tool handle in an item frame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4155755fdaca7bc8ed565bb295a0d934b67de97d_0.webp)

- The Wither no longer drops Nether Stars, instead The Wither now drops Star Cores, which can be used to craft Nether Stars, along with Netherite Ingots

![A Star Core](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f2aff4793d32eeb10660b50fff21919f58e008e_0.webp)

- Acient Debris can no longer be smelted into Netherite Scrap in Furnaces or Blast Furnaces, instead you must now use the Netherite Forge, a new workbench, to smelt 3 Ancient Debris into 1 Netherite Scrap.

![Netherite Forge Workbench spinning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/157b19af88b9a73d2b8b595e1e9201584f2435f6.gif)

![The Netherite Workbench GUI. There is an empty bucket in the fuel slot, 1 ancient debris in input slots 1, 2,  and 3. and 1 netherite scrap in the output slot. The heat bar is full and green, and the fuel bar is 2/3 of the way full.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f85a29730204aa7a60f0a7d18f4528236747d97_0.webp)
